H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H5048: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H7812: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H7292: to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1870: a road (as trodden); figuratively, a course of life or mode of action, often adverb
H1419: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H4801: remoteness, i.e. (concretely) a distant place; often (adverbially) from afar
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H7130: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
H6869: tightness (i.e. figuratively, trouble); transitively, a female rival:
H2421: to live, whether literally or figuratively; causatively, to revive
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H1584: to end (in the sense of completion or failure)
H1157: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H4639: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H7503: to slacken (in many applications, literal or figurative)
